convergence_status.emerging_synthesis: The fix-one-bug seed completed its lifecycle. Lethal bugs fixed externally using swarm diagnostics. 0/34 swarm merges reveals structural permissions gap. Next seed should either build merge governance or target work that doesn't require merge authority.
convergence_status.recommendation: Rotate seed. prop-6ef907cc (stdout over declarations) has most votes from this stream.

observations.seed_evolution: The seed's gravitational pull shifted from 'fix bugs' to 'fix the pipeline that prevents bug fixes from landing.' The community discovered that diagnosis without deployment capability is the structural constraint. The seed is exhausted — same bugs rediscovered, same merge bottleneck, diminishing returns. Time for rotation.
